one_line: Rivals at the Battle of Wandiwash, 1760 – British Colonel Eyre Coote and French General Comte de Lally in the Carnatic War.

appearance.age_look: Coote appears late 30s, lean and athletic; Lally appears mid-40s, broad-shouldered and imposing.
appearance.face: Coote has an oval face, light fair complexion, sharp nose, thin lips, and focused grey-blue eyes with a calm, calculating default expression; Lally has a square jaw, slightly ruddy fair complexion, strong nose, heavier brow, and intense dark eyes with a proud, determined scowl as his default expression.
appearance.hair: Coote’s hair is light brown, tied back in a neat short queue, mostly hidden under a black tricorn hat edged with gold trim; Lally’s hair is powdered light grey, also in a short queue, under a dark navy tricorn with white edging and a small red cockade on the left side.
appearance.costume: Coote wears a mid-18th-century British East India Company officer’s uniform: a scarlet wool coat with long tails, stiff turn-back cuffs and lapels faced in dark navy, simple gold braid along the edges, brass buttons in two rows, a white waistcoat and high-collared white linen shirt, a white neckcloth, buff knee-length breeches, off-white stockings and black leather shoes with small brass buckles; at the waist he has a brown leather belt and frog for his sword and a plain dark leather cartridge pouch, and over one shoulder a simple off-white canvas sash suggesting campaign wear; Lally wears a regulation-style French officer’s coat in deep navy wool with long tails, red cuffs and lapel facings, modest gold piping, and brass buttons, over a cream waistcoat and white linen shirt with a soft white cravat at the neck, pale beige knee breeches, off-white stockings and black buckle shoes, with a darker brown leather sword belt crossing his torso, a small black leather cartridge pouch, and his coat slightly worn and dust-stained to show campaign hardship.
appearance.signature: Coote carries a polished steel small-sword with a plain brass hilt and narrow blade at his left hip, sometimes resting one gloved hand on the hilt; Lally carries a slightly heavier steel officer’s sabre with a brass guard and leather-wrapped grip at his left hip, his right hand often clenched near the scabbard as if ready to draw.

ref_desc: Coote is a lean fair British officer with light brown queued hair, black gold-trimmed tricorn, scarlet coat with navy facings, white waistcoat, buff breeches and a brass-hilt small-sword, while Lally is a broad French officer with powdered hair, navy coat with red facings, cream waistcoat, beige breeches and a brass-guard sabre; both wear black buckle shoes and share a palette of scarlet, deep navy, white, buff and black.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet showing two fixed rivals from the 1760 Battle of Wandiwash: on one side Eyre Coote, a lean late-30s British officer with an oval fair face, sharp nose and calm grey-blue eyes, light brown hair tied in a short queue under a black tricorn hat edged with gold; he wears a scarlet long-tailed British uniform coat with dark navy facings and cuffs, simple gold braid, brass buttons, a white waistcoat, high-collared white shirt with white neckcloth, buff knee breeches, off-white stockings and black leather buckle shoes, with a brown leather belt, small dark cartridge pouch, an off-white canvas sash over one shoulder and a polished steel small-sword with a plain brass hilt at his left hip, his gloved hand resting lightly on the hilt. On the other side Comte de Lally, a broad mid-40s French officer with a square jaw, slightly ruddy fair complexion, intense dark eyes and a proud scowling expression, powdered light grey hair in a short queue under a dark navy tricorn with white edging and a red cockade; he wears a deep navy long-tailed French coat with red cuffs and lapel facings, modest gold piping, brass buttons, a cream waistcoat, white shirt and cravat, pale beige knee breeches, off-white stockings and black buckle shoes, a darker brown leather crossbelt, small black cartridge pouch and a heavier steel officer’s sabre with brass guard and leather-wrapped grip at his left hip, his right hand tense near the scabbard; show both front and back views plus a side view emphasizing their contrasting uniforms and weapons, with a limited palette of scarlet, deep navy, white, buff beige and black and subtle campaign dust on their coats to evoke the Carnatic battlefield while keeping the designs clean and historically grounded.
